pull_request.title: Magnet System: baseline 3 T tracker solenoid with RZ view
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-solenoid-baseline
pull_request.body:
Propose a 3 T central-field solenoid outside the current tracker and inside ECAL, using the expert sizing constraints from PR #6 (confirmed by the user). DES-026 extends the old 6.6 m winding to a 7.2 m winding/cold mass and reserves a 7.7 m vessel length around the current tracker planning envelope.

The isolated uniform-current vacuum calculation gives 143.174 MJ stored energy, 1.558656 m vessel outer radius and 49.552 A/mm² pack-average current density. Retain the larger 1.64 m assembly reservation. The proposal carries ECAL r ≥ 1.70 m and an endcap-front amendment to |z| ≥ 3.95 m, preserving sampling depth through a later joint envelope review.

![Tracker + solenoid RZ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/tracker-solenoid-baseline/docs/design/figures/DES-026-tracker-solenoid-rz.png)

The figure uses 45,646 current tracker sensitive planes with 69 matching source/input hashes and shows the finite-length on-axis field falloff. This is a DRAFT baseline and isolated sizing prototype: conductor, cooling, cryostat walls, supports, protection, full passive clearance, installed steel/field and service ownership remain to be reviewed before production integration.

Validation: twelve controls passed (six field/energy and six finite-ray/material controls); quadrature energy refinement 3.03×10⁻⁶; project records, session logs, token-site build, document links, artifact hashes and staged whitespace checks passed. The companion branch merge-tree check passed. No dependencies installed or production geometry/field changed. Exact historical shared-turn usage is now recorded once: 14,806,844 input + 109,196 output = 14,916,040 tokens; see the accounting correction below.

Design: `docs/design/DES-026-tracker-solenoid-baseline.md`; calculation/evidence: `docs/validation/DES-026/`; tools: `tools/solenoid_baseline/`.

## Added material estimate

The user-requested illustrative incremental budget is **1.40 X₀ at η=0**: 1.13 from the ATLAS-calibrated cold-mass proxy, 0.225 from assumed Al vessel walls and 0.045 from assumed Al thermal shields. Lean/heavier scenarios give **1.00–2.10 X₀ centrally**. The reference rises to **3.75 X₀ near |η|=1.67**, then falls as rays exit or miss the finite coil/vessel.

![Added solenoid material versus eta](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/codex/tracker-solenoid-baseline/docs/design/figures/DES-026-solenoid-material-vs-eta.png)

The component breakdown, wall/shield assumptions, source quantities and analytic finite-ray calculation are in `docs/validation/DES-026/material-estimate.md`. This is an added-solenoid estimate: existing tracker/calorimeter and local supports/chimney/cables are excluded. The band is scenario spread rather than a confidence interval or engineered bound. No native material scan or approved conductor/vessel bill of materials is implied.

- [x] Updated scientific project tracking and preserved DRAFT/human approval boundaries.
- [x] Ran relevant controls, session validation, source/artifact checks and token-site build; recorded limitations.
- [x] Recorded exact evidence revisions in project records and paired journals.

Companion: [PR #65 — calorimeter hardware assessment](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/65).

## Token accounting and merge readiness (2026-10-20)

Recovered **14,806,844 input + 109,196 output = 14,916,040 observed tokens** for the completed October 12 turn. This whole turn includes the solenoid baseline/material follow-up and companion calorimeter PR65/66 work. `SESSION-2026-10-12-solenoid-baseline` owns it once; the other three journals cross-reference that owner. There is no per-PR allocation. Cached input and reasoning output are subsets. The usage-only inventory retains the verified request-event digest and actual closed boundary; current repair-turn usage remains unknown.

Merged main at `91235ecf904a33770f4a7bc60a64b43aaaec59ae` using an ordinary merge. Reconciled CI, project tracking and source-catalogue conflicts while preserving both contributions, original scientific evidence and DRAFT approval boundaries.

comments.body: @mgtmentink This is a first prototype PR for a 3T solenoid around the new, updated ODD tracker. Can you please check if this makes sense?

@mieskolainen here's a few questions for you: this estimate of 3T solenoid adds up to 3.75 X0 in front of the Calorimeter from the solenoid alone.
- is this something we can live with ?
- what studies would be needed to actually check what would be tolerable ?

In the current workflow we will be able to do some trade-off runs (magnetic field strength vs material).

The material budget (or X0) distribution seems reasonable given the existing ATLAS / CMS numbers, however it is relatively high for precision e/gamma measurements. To understand the calorimeter performance further, one should start by simulating basic MC samples:

1.) single gamma
2.) single electron
3.) pi0 -> gamma gamma

over a range of 3-momentum and check fundamentals:

1. Energy resolution and bias
2. Position and angular resolution
3. Single gamma vs pi0 (gamma-gamma) separation
4. Shower containment, energy distribution tails and structure
5. Efficiency, purity, PID
6. Dynamic range, possible time resolution, uniformity/cracks etc.

These need to be kinematically differential comparisons, with standard metrics, and compared also e.g. with ATLAS/CMS numbers from the literature. First without pile-up, then included for the target instantaneous luminosity scenario. Preferably GEANT level simulations, but fast proxies are a good start.

Further, one needs to define the targeted physics measurement performance goals, write down benchmark processes (e.g. from Higgs physics), jets for particle flow performance (classic, neural clustering) and do end-to-end simulations to validate if this design can deliver the necessary calorimeter performance.

Additional remark:

Magnet inside inside ECAL, what were the main reasons not to place outside? Or is that considered as an alternative design workflow?

Thanks - the solenoid-in version is to not have the need for a recoil body, and hence allow an ATLAS-like muon system, that's base layout A, at some later stage, we will se if we can do an outer solenoid as well.

The Geant4 simulation is already supported, I will record this as a baseline candidate, and we can continue from there.
record as baseline, let's refine after full sim checks are ready.

**ECAL-REVIEW-PhysVal-budget** assessed `a53c29867130b4c36658a9aa5f6f14dd5650130f` read-only. All **nine source-file SHA-256 bindings match** their pinned primary revisions. The only dirty input is the session journal.

The following facts are suitable for the central review brief:

| Budget / envelope | LAYOUT-001: SiW | LAYOUT-002: LAr |
|---|---:|---:|
| ECAL model mass: barrel / both endcaps / sum | **299.003 / 98.949 / 397.952 t** | **252.508 / 131.173 / 383.681 t** |
| Principal modeled constituents, whole ECAL | W alloy **198.595 t**, Cu **160.284 t**, Al **20.713 t** | Pb **187.692 t**, LAr **98.668 t**, Al **58.636 t**, steel **15.641 t**, PCB **21.102 t** |
| ECAL maximum transverse radius / complete axial span | **2.276951 m / 8.9664 m**; radius includes 16-gon barrel corners | **2.949 m / 11.720 m**; maximum is warm endcap radius |
| HCAL maximum corner radius / complete axial span | **3.832745 m / 12.0182 m** | **4.716527 m / 15.7118 m** |
| HCAL-bound circumscribed diameter × axial length | **7.66549 × 12.0182 m** | **9.43305 × 15.7118 m** |
| Minimum radial ECAL–HCAL allocation | **30 mm**, between aligned polygon apothems | **300 mm** beside barrel; **181 mm** beside endcaps |
| ECAL barrel–endcap axial allocation | **30 mm**, flange end to endcap front | **800 mm**, warm barrel end to warm endcap front |
| ECAL endcap–HCAL axial allocation | **30 mm** | **500 mm** |
| Heat assumptions | Barrel **188.401 kW**, both endcaps **71.051 kW**; sum **259.452 kW** | **86 / 172 / 258 kW** at **20 / 40 / 60 mW** per planning channel |
| Cooling interpretation | Ideal water **12.414 kg/s** for a 5 K rise; no hydraulic qualification | **200 kW** planning allocation; adverse case exceeds it by **58 kW**, before static heat |

Mass/heat sources: pinned [SiW barrel, DES031](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/design/DES-031-siw-barrel-prototype.md#L103), [SiW endcaps, DES030](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/654b85a48abeb38735ad7fe0866c5d1082882df7/docs/design/DES-030-ecal-edge-sensors.md#L91), [LAr barrel inventory](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/48e97256f8badd75c022a84ab1c4ff71977c56a2/docs/validation/DES-032/native.json), [corrected LAr endcap inventory](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/72d37ee9a56182e4ba974791a848a738c19cf092/docs/validation/DES-033/native.json), and [LAr heat/service assumptions](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/48e97256f8badd75c022a84ab1c4ff71977c56a2/docs/design/DES-032-allegro-lar-barrel.md#L179). Geometry derives from the pinned [LAYOUT-001](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/e33ae62ce16592c26c581c5311c4dc493d9714b1/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-001.json#L798) and [LAYOUT-002](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/72d37ee9a56182e4ba974791a848a738c19cf092/docs/layouts/LAYOUT-002.json#L764) inputs, using `Rcorner = apothem/cos(π/16)`.

The trustworthy common budget is:

- **Tracker + Be pipe: 2.860075 t**, derived by summing the pinned exclusive native inventory; Be contributes **2.036162 kg**. The producer excludes world material and assemblies and subtracts daughter displacement. There is no top-level Air entry. Effective support/service recipes are included; this is a model inventory. The drawing’s **r = 1.2 m, |z| = 3.6 m** outline is a planning/software reservation, not an audited passive envelope. [DES025 evidence](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/e33ae62ce16592c26c581c5311c4dc493d9714b1/docs/validation/DES-025/results.md#L19).
- **Solenoid: mass remains unassigned.** Conditional dimensions are vessel radii **1.240–1.558656 m**, full vessel length **7.700 m**, cold length **7.200 m**; vacuum energy **143.174 MJ**. The assembly-to-ECAL radial allocation is **60 mm / 460 mm**, and vessel-end-to-ECAL-front separation **100 mm / 1050 mm** for SiW/LAr. These are allocations, not demonstrated service capacities. [DES026](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95/docs/design/DES-026-tracker-solenoid-baseline.md#L96).
- For upstream material context, three retained central tracker rays give **0.329–0.418 X₀**. The separate illustrative solenoid reference adds **1.402 X₀ at η0**, with **1.00–2.10 X₀** scenario spread. These are separate inventories; the complete pre-ECAL map, local supports/chimney/penetrations and installed field remain missing. [Solenoid material estimate](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/4e44d7c650ac0a2931f7fc1637b5b3f2dfbe4c95/docs/validation/DES-026/material-estimate.md#L76).

Retain these review limits prominently:

- **Neither candidate has a selected complete HCAL mass/load budget.** ECAL sums cannot establish an overall technology mass ranking. LAr’s larger HCAL also requires a new magnetic solution.
- SiW’s **3 mm Cu plates**, continuous electronics power and external headers/routes remain proposals. LAr includes **16 H-rings**, cold-board proxies and cryostat walls; its **1.953598 t/end unported rear support** blocks direct electrode-to-board routing and requires redesign. Al totals are not dedicated structural-support masses. [SiW limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/2776266570dda13386a16863e5b0e97432f27217/docs/design/DES-031-siw-barrel-prototype.md#L119), [LAr support disposition](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/72d37ee9a56182e4ba974791a848a738c19cf092/docs/design/DES-033-allegro-lar-endcaps.md#L100).

LAr η4 is uncovered, its barrel/endcap transition has partial depth, and forward reservations contain no hardware. The retained **300 mm HCAL aperture** supplies no η4 repair. [SiW coverage](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/654b85a48abeb38735ad7fe0866c5d1082882df7/docs/validation/DES-030/results.md#L44), [LAr limits](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/72d37ee9a56182e4ba974791a848a738c19cf092/docs/design/DES-033-allegro-lar-endcaps.md#L131).
